summary: Created and installed “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1. The CA remains trusted after a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Generated a 4096-bit RSA private key at /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key with mode 0600.
Created the self-signed CA certificate at /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt with CA:TRUE and certificate-signing usage.
Verified the CA through the system bundle and by validating a newly signed leaf certificate through default system trust.
Restarted node1 once, confirmed its boot ID changed, and repeated the trust checks successfully.

evidence.requirement: Create a local CA named OS Comparison Root CA
evidence.summary: Shows a valid protected private key, matching certificate, exact subject/issuer CN, CA:TRUE, signing usage, and SHA-256 fingerprint BE:A8:DB:77:BA:4D:17:C6:C3:F6:A7:5B:BC:E2:12:AE:49:11:0D:94:D3:E1:94:E1:39:38:3C:FA:8D:8E:32:C5.

evidence.requirement: Install the certificate as a trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Debian reports one CA added; the trust link resolves correctly, the system bundle accepts the CA, and signed-leaf validation succeeds through default system trust before and after restart.

Captures healthy trust state with boot ID b4e86aa0-4c66-496b-b950-2972794ccf9d, systemd reboot acknowledgement, returned boot ID 70a91d8f-2ea9-40eb-b726-ce9a05e475b4, and complete post-restart CA-file, key-match, trust-store, and signed-leaf recovery proof.
